question: Which of the following structural elements is characteristic of the ortopramide group drugs?

options.opa: They are anilides with propyl group in ortho.
options.opb: They are benzamides with methoxy group in ortho.
options.opc: They are benzenesulfonamides with a methyl group in ortho.
options.opd: They are ortho-halogenated derivatives of phenothiazine.

analysis: Ortopramide group drugs are anilides with a propyl group in ortho position.
